facts.fact: 树下重逢：他凭步态/呼吸/心跳节奏认出她（「你的心跳通常比多数人慢」）；「I want to show you something」——骑马出游、Argus 托给 Lumi
facts.anchor: It’s your walk, your breathing, and the rhythm of your heart.

facts.fact: 他的出身自述：没有从顶端开始——最低阶的 ship's boy 跑腿挨骂；「The sea is where I feel most at home; much like you while on your horse」；受过爱的童年
兄长 Bakar 之死：蛇毒蔓延到心脏、兄弟们四散寻找他人未及赶回——他是在场的那个人；「He says it as if he were not a deserving recipient」；妹妹 Andilyn 与亡兄同住、几乎被击碎
facts.anchor: And I was the one there.

facts.fact: Death Benefit 之重：他经历了 Bakar 高烧碎裂的记忆（最好的那些）——最难的是转述给家人（「My words did little to replace the detail I saw in his mind」）
facts.anchor: I lived Bakar’s memories—fragmented by his fever

facts.fact: 五岁的第一次 Death Benefit：不知为何——「她大概觉得我能承受」——至今仍在求解；「Don't worry about what burdens me」她说再也不听这句了
facts.anchor: She must have thought I could carry it.

facts.fact: 瞭望塔授海：他的手覆上她的手——「这是我的海」；东北=Dranderon 首都（耐火岩、军团攻不破）；Sunder 史与 Reynolds 挡水渡民（「He nearly died holding the water back」——这正是 Vine 挑战重要性的由来，但她不能告诉他）
facts.anchor: This, Draven Artrayu, is my sea.

facts.fact: 护符解密：他早知「onyx 是一枚 Brinden Stone」（「我见过 Power Stones——你握过它几次」）；Cadmar 直接问石不犯忌——「I'd let him in anywhere」
石头亡国史：Arkendrath 无 imbuer——Sunder 时 Reynolds 带来的唯一 Lithic Scholar 为 Luxari 注能而死（光先杀了他、也带走了 Luxari 的光）；Drighton 尚有几名 Lithoalchemist 在 Hayden 看管下
facts.anchor: He died trying to imbue for a Luxari.

facts.fact: 调情回环：她笑说要趁他睡着抢劫——「anytime，我可能还挺享受」；她挣开相扣的手装作伸懒腰
Alden 归来：两人像少年一样互相欢呼拥抱；Draven 不嫉妒；「We might actually win this thing!」——「We might.」（那语气像必须两人都成功才算赢）
facts.anchor: He says it like it will take both of us succeeding for it to count as a win.
